name: AiButton
label: AI button
description: The AI entry point: a turning gradient ring that reports the agent's status, with a hover-summoned summary and a panel for what the agent asks of you.

props.name: label
props.description: Button text content

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode)

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Draws the button as a circle holding only its icon, for a tight bar. The label stays as its accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the button is disabled

props.name: state
props.description:
What the agent behind the button is doing, in AgentStatus's vocabulary.
The label never changes; the icon carries the state. `thinking` and
`working` show AgentStatusMark and spin the ring faster, `waiting` shows
the mark breathing in the warning colour with the ring at rest, and `done` and
`error` turn the button to their status colours with the mark filled
solid in the status colour, then return to the resting look after a
beat. The button stays clickable throughout, unlike Button's
`loading`, so a click can open the conversation to watch the work.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: What a screen reader hears when the state changes, per state, merged over the English defaults; `idle` says nothing.

props.name: href
props.description: Optional href — renders as <a> instead of <button>

props.name: target
props.description: Optional target attribute for links

props.name: rel
props.description: Optional rel attribute for links

props.name: summary
props.description:
A TLDR panel the button can summon: overline, title, a pre-written
summary revealed through a skeleton beat and a typed stream (once per
mount — later openings show it instantly, as if cached), and optional
prompt chips. Hovering the button opens it after the standard hover
delay; the pointer keeps it alive anywhere over the button or panel,
and it hides a grace period after leaving both. Omit for the plain
button.

props.name: summaryPlacement
props.description: Which side of the button the summary panel opens on.

props.name: request
props.description:
What the agent needs from the person while `state` is `waiting`: any
content, drawn in a glass panel at the button. An InterruptCard approval
is the usual filling; a question, a form or a preview work the same way.
It opens each time the state becomes `waiting` and stays open without
hover. Escape or a click on the button folds it back into the button,
where the waiting mark keeps showing, and another click opens it again.
While it is open the summary panel never opens.

props.name: requestOpen
props.description: Whether the request panel is open, for a host that owns it (say, to keep it shut while the chat shows the request). Leave undefined to let the button manage it.

props.name: defaultRequestOpen
props.description: Whether the request panel starts open, when the button manages it. Each later move into `waiting` opens it again.

props.name: onRequestOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the request panel opens or closes, including when a move into `waiting` opens it.

props.name: requestPlacement
props.description: Which side of the button the request panel opens on.

props.name: requestRegionLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the request panel.

props.name: summaryPinned
props.description:
Holds the summary panel open regardless of hover — for callers that
reveal it on their own signal (scroll depth, dwell). Hover mechanics
still run when it flips back off.

props.name: onSummaryDismiss
props.description: Fires when the panel's dismiss button is pressed. The panel closes itself either way; hovering away and back re-summons it.

props.name: onSummarySuggestion
props.description: Fires with the tapped summary suggestion's `id`.

props.name: summaryRegionLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the summary panel, given the summary's title. Defaults to "Summary: " followed by the title.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the summary panel's dismiss button.

props.name: suggestionsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the summary panel's group of prompt chips.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component the link renders with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so it
navigates through the app's router. Wins over a LinkProvider's; a plain
`<a>` when neither is set.

AiButtonSummary.description: The content of AiButton's summary panel.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

PromptSuggestion.description: One tappable suggestion in the row.
